construction.nonce: 24 bytes from crypto.getRandomValues() per record; no counter, no durable state
construction.kdf: HKDF-SHA256 via WebCrypto deriveBits, at open
construction.length_prefix: uint16be(byteLength) || utf8 — injective, so no field can shift another
construction.nonce_caveat: Nonces are fixed inputs in these vectors so the composition is testable. Production generates them randomly; the fixed nonce is not the discipline.

primitive_kat.note: Copied from the draft. Never regenerate: a KAT produced by the code it checks proves nothing.
primitive_kat.plaintext_utf8: Ladies and Gentlemen of the class of '99: If I could offer you only one tip for the future, sunscreen would be it.

vectors.name: empty-update
vectors.why: A zero-length plaintext still authenticates; the tag and framing must not depend on payload length.

vectors.name: keystroke-update
vectors.why: An 18-byte Yjs update — the measured size of one keystroke, and the common case for this path.

vectors.name: rotated-generation
vectors.why: Generation is a cleartext header field, so it is in the AAD. A record claiming gen=2 cannot be replayed as gen=1.

vectors.name: second-workspace
vectors.why: Same K_g, same nonce, same plaintext, different workspace. Proves the subkey is workspace-bound.

must_fail.name: wrong-workspace
must_fail.mutate: Derive the subkey for a different workspace id. Tests the HKDF info binding only -- the AAD half is aad-only-other-workspace.

must_fail.name: wrong-generation
must_fail.mutate: Authenticate with gen=2 in the AAD against a record written under gen=1.

must_fail.name: moved-slot
must_fail.mutate: Authenticate with journalKey ...done.8 against a record written for ...done.7.

must_fail.name: flipped-tag-bit
must_fail.mutate: Flip the low bit of the final tag byte.

must_fail.name: truncated-record
must_fail.mutate: Drop the final byte of the record.

must_fail.name: wrong-version-prefix
must_fail.mutate: Replace the "2:" prefix with "1:" (a pre-encryption plaintext entry).

must_fail.name: aad-only-other-workspace
must_fail.mutate: Authenticate with the other workspace in the AAD, subkey unchanged. Isolates the AAD binding from the HKDF info.

must_fail.name: aad-only-hkdf-label
must_fail.mutate: Authenticate with the HKDF label in the AAD label position -- what one constant reached for twice produces.

must_fail.name: aad-only-renumbered-label
must_fail.mutate: Authenticate with "done/jrnl/v2". The label is where this carrier authenticates its own version, so a renumbered record must fail to open rather than select another suite (row 1).
